function.name: terminal
function.description: Run a shell command inside this task's isolated workspace. The process starts at the workspace root, with HOME and HERMES_HOME pointing at this workspace (so ~/.hermes is the profile of this task) and GOOGLE_OAUTH_BASE_URL holding the OAuth endpoints of this workspace. There is no outbound network: package installs and downloads fail by design, only local endpoints answer. Compound commands and pipes are allowed. Output is capped; stale or long-lived servers will be killed when the task ends.

command.description: The shell command to run, e.g. 'python "$HOME/.hermes/skills/productivity/google-workspace/scripts/setup.py" --check'.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file from the workspace. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root; absolute paths and paths escaping the workspace are rejected. Use this for credentials files, tokens, or skill reference text you need to inspect exactly.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default 2000).

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a text file inside the workspace. Parent directories are created automatically. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root; writing outside the workspace is rejected.

function.name: skill_view
function.description: Read a skill's SKILL.md document by name. Available skills in this environment: himalaya (terminal IMAP/SMTP email) and google-workspace (Gmail/Calendar/Drive via OAuth). Load a skill before following its setup procedures.

function.name: clarify
function.description: Ask the user one or more questions when you need a decision, clarification, or feedback before proceeding. Pass every question in `questions` (1-5 entries) — a single question is a one-entry array, and several INDEPENDENT questions belong in ONE call (one form beats a chain of clarify calls; if one answer would change another question, ask separately). Per question: single-select (up to 4 choices — put your recommended option FIRST, the UI marks it '(Recommended)' and auto-appends an 'Other' free-text row), multi-select (multi_select=true), or open-ended (omit choices). Options go ONLY in `choices`, never enumerated inside the question text. Result: {responses: [...]} in question order (plus timed_out=true if the user stopped part-way). Prefer deciding low-stakes questions yourself.

questions.description: The question(s). Each: question text (options excluded), optional choices (recommended first; omit for free-text), optional multi_select. Responses come back in question order with the question text echoed.
